summary: GameAP is a dedicated control panel designed for hosting and administering game servers across both Linux and Windows environments. It provides a centralised web interface to handle server lifecycle management, file access, and operational commands. The backend is written in Go and utilises Docker for containerisation.
goodFor: Self-hosters who run private game servers across mixed operating systems and want a unified web interface to manage them.
watchOut: With a moderate maintenance health score and slowing update velocity, you may encounter unresolved bugs or lack timely support for newer game releases.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, it typically requires a persistent volume for configuration and game data, alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
